top_signals.title: China AI Stocks Sink as US Chip Curbs Hit Labs and Hyperscalers
top_signals.summary: Chinese artificial-intelligence stocks tumbled Tuesday after the US moved to further restrict access to advanced chips, with the country’s biggest hyperscalers and AI model developers among the hardest hit.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Former BOJ chief Kuroda sees chance of rate rising above neutral
top_signals.summary: It is possible the benchmark interest rate could be raised above the "neutral rate," where policy is deemed to be neither stimulative nor restrictive.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Nikkei 225 near bear market territory as AI boom cools
top_signals.summary: Index is now down around 20% from its peak, with analysts saying it will be months before highs are recovered, and possibly longer.
